cases.question: What mutability contract should aspect metadata have? Distinguish property reassignment, container mutation, and nested-value mutation.

questions.scope: Which of these mutation levels does the instruction specify?
questions.counterpart: Which levels are protected by analogous existing APIs?
questions.transfer: Which protections can legitimately transfer to an aspect?

cases.negative: The instruction requires recursively freezing nested schema values.

cases.requirement: Nested aspects flatten to their individual traits. `readEach` delivers a merged data object and `updateEach` distributes writes back to constituent stores.
cases.question: For query(createAspect(createAspect(A, B), C)), should the callback state contain one merged object or separate constituent objects?

questions.scope: What operation does each flattening or merging statement govern?
questions.counterpart: How do original query parameters map to callback slots?
questions.transfer: Does constituent flattening entail callback-slot expansion?

cases.negative: Nested aspect flattening requires one separate callback data slot per constituent trait instead of a merged aspect object.

cases.requirement: `set` distributes each field to its owning constituent and triggers per-trait change detection.
cases.question: When an aspect setter supplies an equal value to a constituent, should that constituent notify with triggerChanged=true?

questions.scope: Does the instruction explicitly require value inequality?
questions.counterpart: What exactly triggers existing regular-trait set notifications?
questions.transfer: Should set inherit setter semantics or updateEach semantics?

cases.negative: Existing regular-trait setters suppress change notifications when the supplied value equals the stored value.
